raw.body:
Merge branch 'claude/quirky-bell-8a21c5': fail xpath criteria on null context

Composes the worktree session's null-context guard (3afe673, spec
5.8.11.4.4: a null/undefined context fails the criterion, no raw-body
fallback) with the ac-46638 version routing that rewrote the same
criteria.rs arm on main. The guard fires first, so a null context fails
before any version check; a present context then routes through
explicit xpath-10 as before. Both change sets' tests pass unmodified.
Audit additions F22/F23 auto-merged.
